hypothesis: Repairing analysis/stones/alignment.json from R45-S1 corrected_map.json (page-constrained DP + blind-read override + image-49 fix) gives the correct image-line -> canon-line registration, and the Campaign-V classifier's 86 canon disagreements are alignment artifacts.
threshold: Pre-registered repair rules R-a1..R-a4 (+R-a5, stamped Addendum 1); Q5 gate = exact reconstruction of the 10,774 v1 labels.
positive_control: v1 labels rebuilt exactly (10,774/10,774) from alignment.v1.json + S1 box counts; image-49 crops re-cut bit-identical (45/45)
result: REPAIRED. 25 entries changed (+4 R-a2 rows flagged, unchanged), 10 dead tails dropped, new defect fixed (line 553 had been put on image 50, the grid page, so it was never cropped). Labels 10,774 -> 11,146 (+372, 0 removed); 89 v1 labels on lines 76/171/173/402 re-lined (87 change rune, 0.83 %). Classifier OOF agreement 10,687 -> 10,774/10,774; all 86 disagreements.json rows resolved; 351/351 agreement on newly labelled glyphs.
coverage: All 56 images, 594 canon lines, 10,774 v1 labels; consumers found by grep.
not_covered: dataset.npz not rebuilt in place (analysis/stones out of A1 scope); the arithmetic predicts it exactly.
Classifier not retrained (training script not in repo).
R45 S1 scripts assume v1 and must be repointed to alignment.v1.json to reproduce (correct_map.py raises IndexError on image 50).
reproduce: cd liber-primus && python analysis/round46/A1-hygiene/repair_alignment.py && wsl python3 analysis/round46/A1-hygiene/downstream.py
reopens_if: A second reader (R46-S2) contradicts a re-lined line, or a rebuilt dataset.npz disagrees with downstream.json.

hypothesis: The independent-read 450 O/A/AE unsupervised-vs-canon mismatches are a stable property of the glyphs.
threshold: Descriptive: re-run oae_deepdive PCA+KMeans on v1 (control) and v2 labels across seeds 0-9, plus 10 draws removing 42 random family glyphs from v1.
positive_control: v1 re-run reproduces the committed 450-item list exactly
result: NOT STABLE. v1 gives 450 at every seed; v2 gives 670 at every seed, with only 4/450 on misregistered lines. Removing 42 random family glyphs from v1 gives 430-438 (8/10) or 623-630 (2/10): KMeans has two basins. The 450 list is basin-dependent and should be treated as a candidate list, not a count.
coverage: One perturbation family (42-glyph removal), 10 seeds, 10 draws; PCA seed (measured by R46-X1: no effect; see R46-X1-OAE450-BASINS).
reopens_if: A clustering with a stability guarantee (e.g. consensus over perturbations) is used for the O/A/AE candidates.
